about: GET /api/ticket/{slug}/of/{wallet} (meter/tickets.py ticket_of). `could_not_look` is the 503 a failed chain read answers: entitled null is 'could not look', never 'does not own'. `trial` and `trial_used_up` are a wallet with no copy on a title with a trial: entitled while trial_minutes_left is above 0, as the game's servers measured it. `addons` maps each add-on's slug to whether the wallet holds it (null: could not look).

free.why: no ticket contract — the game is free

body.why: the chain read failed — this is 'could not look', never 'does not own'

trial_used_up.why: the trial is used up — a copy lets them stay
